div.div: مُحَقَّرَاتٌ Small sins; syn. صَغَائِرُ: (S, K:) but this is an application proper to the law; for the [pagan] Arabs knew not صَغَائِرِ nor كَبَائِر: or, accord. to the writers on strange words, it signifies actions which a man contemns, or despises, or holds in light estimation, even if great sins. (MF.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
